items.title: Bessent Takes Hawkish Turn in White House Debate on China
items.en: Bessent Takes Hawkish Turn in White House Debate on China. The Treasury secretary who sought to de-escalate tariff wars is taking a tougher approach to exports of sensitive U.S. technology.
items.zh: 在白宮的中國議題辯論中，貝森特轉向鷹派立場。這位曾試圖緩和關稅戰的財政部長，現在對美國敏感技術的出口採取了更強硬的態度。

items.title: Berkshire upped its bet on a beleaguered U.S. housing market, while souring on these bank stocks
items.en: Berkshire upped its bet on a beleaguered U.S. housing market, while souring on these bank stocks. Berkshire Hathaway stepped up its investments in the U.S. housing market last quarter, nearly doubling its stake in home builder Lennar.
items.zh: 巴郡加碼押注陷入困境的美國房地產市場，同時對這些銀行股的態度轉趨負面。巴郡 (Berkshire Hathaway) 在上一季加大了對美國房地產市場的投資，將其在房屋營建商 Lennar 的持股增加近一倍。

items.title: JPMorgan Chase says temporary software bug is affecting consumer banking
items.en: JPMorgan Chase says temporary software bug is affecting consumer banking. CNBC's Eamon Javers reported there was no indication of bad actors involved and likewise no indication that a bug was impacting multiple banks at the same time.
items.zh: 摩根大通表示，暫時性的軟體錯誤正在影響消費者銀行業務。CNBC 的 Eamon Javers 報導稱，沒有跡象表明有惡意行為者參與其中，也沒有跡象表明有漏洞同時影響多家銀行。

items.title: New rule aims to close loophole on chip exports
items.en: New rule aims to close loophole on chip exports. The Commerce Department released a new rule designed to make it harder for China to gain access to America's most powerful computer chips using third-country data centers.
items.zh: 新規定旨在堵住晶片出口的漏洞。美國商務部發布了一項新規定，旨在讓中國更難透過第三國的資料中心取得美國最強大的電腦晶片。

items.title: Altimeter's Brad Gerstner aims to invest $5 billion in Anthropic IPO
items.en: Altimeter's Brad Gerstner aims to invest $5 billion in Anthropic IPO. Gerstner told CNBC that he's looking to put five time as much money into Anthropic as he's ever put into an IPO.
items.zh: Altimeter 的 Brad Gerstner 計劃在 Anthropic 的首次公開發行 (IPO) 中投資 50 億美元。格斯特納 (Gerstner) 告訴 CNBC，他希望將比以往投入 IPO 的資金多五倍的資金投入 Anthropic。
